originalTitle: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
title: Missing Mums and Dads: A Very Long Search in Africa!
content:
Hello, Friends! From Africa Fun News!

Hi everyone! It's your friend, Reporter Fara, here from Africa Fun News! Get ready for a very important story from a special country in Africa called Eritrea. It's a story that might make us feel a little bit sad, but it's super important to understand why it matters to many families.

We're going to talk about children who are now grown-ups, and their mums and dads who have been missing for a very, very long time. They are searching for answers, and we can listen to their story with our big, kind hearts.

What Happened a Long, Long Time Ago?

Imagine this: a very, very long time ago. How long? Think about 25 years! Wow! That's like when your parents were much, much younger, maybe even before your big brother or sister was born! Or even before YOU were born!

Did you know? 25 years is a quarter of 100 years! That’s a super long time for anyone to be away from their family.

In Eritrea, a country in Africa, some very important people, like leaders who helped their country a lot, were taken away from their homes. They were put in a place where they couldn't go back home to their families. We call this being 'jailed' or 'imprisoned'.

The really sad part is that after they were taken, no one saw them again. No one knew where they went! It's like they just disappeared into thin air, and their families were left wondering.

Who Were These Brave Mums and Dads?

These mums and dads were not just any people. They were like heroes for their country, Eritrea! They loved their country very much and worked super hard to make it a free and safe place for everyone.

Think about a superhero, but a real-life one, who helps their community and makes big changes for the better. That's what these people did! They helped Eritrea become independent and strong.

Did you know? A hero can be anyone who helps others, like a doctor who makes people well, a teacher who helps you learn, or even a friend who shares their toys and is kind!

The Sad Day 25 Years Ago

One day, without warning or explanation, these important people were taken away from their homes and their loved ones. Their families – their wives, husbands, and especially their young children – didn't understand what was happening.

It was a very confusing and scary time for them. Imagine if your mum or dad suddenly wasn't there one morning, and no one could tell you where they went. It would be very sad and worrying.

The families tried to find out where they were or why this was happening, but they couldn't get any answers.

The Children Are Now Grown-Ups

Those little children who were left behind 25 years ago are not little anymore. They are big grown-ups now! Some of them might even have their own children, your age!

But even after all these years, they still don't know where their mums and dads are. They have lived their whole lives without knowing what happened to them.

They don't know if their parents are safe, if they are healthy, or even if they are still alive. Imagine not knowing where your mum or dad is for your entire life! It’s a very heavy sadness to carry.

Why Do They Want Answers So Much?

These grown-up children just want one thing: to know the truth. They want to know what happened to their parents. They want to know why they were taken away all those years ago. And they want to know where they are now.

It's very important for families to know what happened to their loved ones. It helps them to understand, to heal, and to have peace in their hearts. Not knowing leaves a big, empty space.

Did you know? In many African cultures, family is super, super important! Not just your mum and dad, but also your aunties, uncles, cousins, and grandparents. Everyone helps each other!

Let's Learn About Eritrea!

Eritrea is a beautiful country located in the eastern part of Africa. It's right next to the Red Sea, which is a very famous and important sea!

Did you know? Eritrea's capital city is Asmara! It's famous for its unique old buildings that look very special, like art you can live in!

Did you know? Eritrea has nine different groups of people, and they all have their own special languages and traditions! It’s like having many different families living together in one big, happy country!

What Does 'Jailed' Really Mean?

When someone is 'jailed' or 'imprisoned', it means they are put into a special building. This building has guards and locked doors, and people cannot leave until they are allowed to. Usually, this happens if someone has broken the law.

But in this story, these heroes were taken and put in jail without anyone knowing why. Their families couldn't even visit them or send them letters. This is not how things should be, is it? It's not fair to hide people away without good reason and without telling their families.

Everyone deserves to be treated fairly, and to have their rights respected, especially when they have done so much good for their country.

Why This Story is Important to All of Us

This story from Eritrea is important for all of us, even if we live far away. It teaches us a few big things:

1. **Families are precious:** Everyone deserves to know where their family is and to be with them. Families are the heart of our homes.

2. **Fairness is key:** Heroes and all people should be treated fairly. No one should just disappear without anyone knowing why.

3. **Speaking up helps:** Even though we are kids, we can learn about important things happening in the world. Learning and talking about them can help bring change.

Did you know? Remembering stories like this helps us learn about fairness and why it's important for everyone to be treated well and with respect, no matter where they are from!

What Can We Do?

Even if we are far away, we can think kind thoughts for the grown-up children who are still searching for their mums and dads. We can hope that they find the answers they are looking for very soon.

We can also try to be kind and fair in our own lives, every single day. Let's make sure our friends and family always feel loved and safe.

So, let's keep this story in our hearts and remember how important it is for families to be together and for everyone to be treated with truth and kindness. Let's send our warmest wishes to Eritrea!

That's all for today from Reporter Fara, on Africa Fun News! See you next time for more amazing stories from our beautiful continent!
summary: Children in Eritrea are looking for their parents who disappeared 25 years ago after being put in jail, and they want to know what happened to them.
whyMatters: It's important because everyone deserves to know where their family is, and people should always be treated fairly, especially those who help their country.

originalTitle: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
title: Let's Talk About Being Kind and Safe!
content:
Hello, Little Superstars!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly news reporter, here to chat with you. Today, we are going to talk about something important. Sometimes, grown-ups talk about things that might make us feel a little bit sad. But don't worry! We are talking about it so we can all understand and help make our world a happier, safer place. Grown-ups are always working hard to keep you safe and sound. We love you all very much! We want everyone to feel happy and loved every single day. This is about making sure all people, especially ladies and girls, feel safe. We learn about kindness in school. We learn to share our toys. We learn to be good friends. Being kind is a super important superpower!

Why Grown-Ups Are Talking

Sometimes, in our lovely country, South Africa, sad things happen. Grown-ups have been talking about some ladies who have been hurt. One of the ladies' names was Dineo Motapane. She was a person, just like your mommy or auntie or big sister. These sad things made many people feel worried and unhappy. It's like when your friend gets a boo-boo, and you feel sad for them. Grown-ups want to understand why these sad things are happening. They want to make sure it stops. They want everyone to live safely. Everyone deserves to feel safe. No one should ever feel scared. We all want to live in a place where we can play and laugh without any worries. *Did you know?* South Africa is a beautiful country with many different animals, like lions and elephants! It's also home to many kind people.

Feeling Sad and Worried

It's okay to feel a little bit sad or worried when you hear about sad things. Even grown-ups feel sad sometimes. If you hear grown-ups talking about something that makes you feel a bit scared, it's good to talk about it. You can talk to your mommy, daddy, gogo, or a trusted teacher. They are there to listen to you. They will give you a big hug. Talking about our feelings helps us feel better. Remember, your feelings are important. Grown-ups want to help you understand things in a way that is not too scary. They will remind you that you are safe. *Did you know?* Sharing your feelings is like letting out a little cloud of worry. It makes space for sunshine!

What Grown-Ups Are Doing to Help

Many grown-ups are working together like a big team. They are talking to each other. They are thinking very hard about how to stop these sad things from happening again. The police are also working very hard. They are looking for people who do bad things. They want to help everyone. The government, which is like the big team that helps run our country, is also helping. They are making plans. They want to make sure all ladies and girls are protected. They want everyone to feel safe when they walk outside. They want homes to be safe places too. It's a big job, but many people care very much. They are like superheroes working behind the scenes! *Did you know?* The word "police" comes from an old Greek word meaning "city" or "state," because they help keep our cities and states safe!

Being Kind and Respectful

This is a super important part! Everyone, big and small, boy or girl, deserves to be treated with kindness. We must always be respectful. Respect means treating others how you would like to be treated. It means listening to people. It means not hurting anyone with our words or our hands. Ladies and girls are very strong and clever. They deserve respect, just like everyone else. We can all practice kindness every day. We can say "please" and "thank you." We can share our snacks. We can help a friend who falls down. When we are kind, we make the world a brighter place for everyone. It makes people feel good inside. *Did you know?* A smile is a powerful thing! It can make someone's day and it doesn't cost a thing.

Keeping Everyone Safe

Grown-ups are always thinking about how to keep you safe. Here are some simple safety tips: 1. **Always be with a trusted grown-up:** When you go outside to play, or when you go to the shops, make sure you are with an adult you know and trust. 2. **Tell a grown-up if something feels wrong:** If someone says something that makes you feel uncomfortable, or if you see something that makes you feel scared, tell your mommy, daddy, gogo, or teacher right away. 3. **Know your family's special word:** Sometimes families have a secret word. Only people who know the word are allowed to pick you up. Ask your parents if you can have one! 4. **Listen to your grown-ups:** They always tell you things for your safety. These are just little ways we can all help. Grown-ups are the ones who make the big plans. They will make sure things get better. *Did you know?* Your brain is like a super-smart computer that helps you know when something doesn't feel right. Listen to it!

We Are All a Team!

Our community is like a big family. We all look out for each other. When something sad happens, we all feel it. And when we work together, we can make things better. Grown-ups are teaching all of us, boys and girls, to be kind and respectful. They are teaching us that violence is never okay. It means hurting someone, and that's not how we treat people we care about. We want everyone to live in peace. We want happy families and happy neighbourhoods. We want a future where everyone feels safe to play, learn, and grow. Let's remember to be good friends to each other and always help if someone needs it. *Did you know?* The African proverb "Ubuntu" means "I am because we are." It reminds us that we are all connected and need each other!

Let's Share Love and Care

So, even though we heard about some sad news today, remember this: there are many, many good people in South Africa. They are working hard to make sure everyone is safe and loved. We can all help by being kind to each other every single day. Let's make sure our homes, schools, and playgrounds are full of smiles and laughter. Let's share love and care with everyone we meet. You, little superstars, are the future. With kindness in your hearts, you will help build an even more wonderful world! Thank you for listening. Keep shining bright!
summary: Grown-ups in South Africa are working hard to stop bad things from happening to women and to make sure everyone feels safe and is treated with kindness and respect.
whyMatters: It's important because everyone, especially women and girls, deserves to feel safe and loved, and by talking about it, grown-ups can make things better for everyone.

originalTitle: 'Enough is enough': Women protest after string of murders near Johannesburg
title: Brave Women Speak Up for Safety in Johannesburg!
content:
Hello, my wonderful friends! I'm your kid-friendly news reporter from Africa. Today, we have a very important story from a big city in South Africa called Johannesburg. Sometimes, sad things happen, but people are working together to make sure everyone feels safe and happy.

What Happened?

Not long ago, some grown-up women near a place called Kempton Park in Johannesburg felt very, very sad and worried. This was because some bad things happened to other women. It made everyone feel a little bit scared. It's like when you hear that a friend got hurt, and you feel sad for them and a little worried too. The grown-ups in Kempton Park felt just like that. They wanted to do something to help and make things better. Did you know? Johannesburg is one of the biggest cities in South Africa! It's a busy place with lots of people, cars, and tall buildings.

Brave Women Speak Out

When people feel sad or worried about something important, they sometimes come together to share their feelings. This is called a protest. Imagine if you and your friends all wanted to tell your parents something important – you might all talk to them together! That's what happened in Kempton Park. Many brave women came together. They held signs, and they marched peacefully. A sign is like a big poster with words on it to share a message. They marched to say, "Enough is enough!" This means they wanted the bad things to stop. They wanted to feel safe when they walked outside or went about their day. They wanted everyone to be safe. It's very brave to stand up and speak out for what you believe in. These women were showing everyone that they care about each other and want a safe place to live.

Police Are Helping!

When something bad happens, the police are there to help us. The police are like special helpers in our communities. Their job is to keep us safe and to find out who does bad things. In Johannesburg, the police heard the women's voices. They knew they needed to do something special. So, they set up something called a 'task team'. A task team is like a special group of police officers. Imagine your teachers choosing a special team of students to solve a big puzzle. That's what a task team does, but for police work! This special police team's job is to look very carefully into what happened to the women. They want to find out who did these bad things and make sure they can't hurt anyone else. They are working very hard to keep everyone safe. Did you know? Police officers wear special uniforms and often drive cars with flashing lights to help them do their important job quickly and safely!

Staying Safe Together

The police also shared some important advice for everyone, especially the women in Kempton Park. They said it's very important to not walk or run alone, especially in quiet places. Quiet places are spots where there might not be many other people around, like a park when it's empty, or a street that doesn't have many houses or shops. Why is this important? Because it's always safer to be with a friend, a brother or sister, or a grown-up. When you are with someone else, you are much safer. Think about it: Would you rather go exploring in a new place alone, or with a grown-up who knows the way and can help if you get lost? It's the same idea for safety. Always tell a grown-up where you are going. If you are going to a friend's house, let your mom or dad know. If you're playing outside, make sure they know where you are.

Our Community Cares

This story shows us something very important: when people work together, they can make a big difference. The women who protested were brave, and the police are working hard to help. Everyone in the community wants the same thing: for all people to feel safe, happy, and loved. When we help each other and look out for each other, our communities become stronger. Did you know? A 'community' is all the people who live in the same area, like your neighbourhood or town. When everyone in a community works together, amazing things can happen! So, remember, my friends: Always listen to your grown-ups about staying safe. If you ever feel scared or worried, always tell a grown-up you trust. They are there to help you! We will keep watching this story, hoping for good news. Let's all hope that with everyone's help, Johannesburg and all of Africa will be a safe and happy place for everyone, especially our wonderful women and girls.
summary: Brave women in Johannesburg protested for safety after sad events, leading police to create a special team to investigate and giving advice to stay safe by not walking alone.
whyMatters: This story matters because everyone, especially women and children, deserves to feel safe and happy wherever they live, and by speaking up and working together, communities can make their homes safer for all.

originalTitle: Salah scores hat-trick as Trabzonspor beat Galatasaray in Turkish league
title: Our African Hero Salah Scores Three Goals! Hooray!
content:
Hello, amazing friends! Welcome to your special African Kids News! Today, we have super exciting news about one of Africa's biggest football stars. Are you ready? His name is Mohamed Salah! He did something truly fantastic in a football game far away. Let's find out all about it!

Who is Mohamed Salah?

Mohamed Salah is a very famous football player. He is from Egypt! Egypt is a wonderful country right here in Africa. That makes him an African hero, just like you! Salah is known all over the world for being super fast. He can run with the ball like lightning! He also scores many, many goals. He makes people happy when he plays. Many kids in Africa look up to him and want to play football just like him. Did you know? People sometimes call Mohamed Salah "The Egyptian King" because he is so good at football and makes his country and continent proud!

What is Football?

Before we jump into the big news, let's talk about football! Football is a super fun game played with a ball. Two teams try to kick the ball into the other team's net. When you get the ball into the net, it's called a "goal"! The team with the most goals wins. It's a game that makes you run a lot and stay healthy. Many kids in Africa love to play football in the streets, in school, or anywhere they can find space. It's a game of teamwork and lots of excitement!

A Super Special Day for Salah!

Mohamed Salah played in a big game recently. This game was played in a country called Turkey. Turkey is a bit far from Africa, but many great African players go there to play for different teams. In this game, Salah was playing for a team called Trabzonspor. They were playing against another strong team called Galatasaray. It was a very important match. Everyone was watching! And guess what? Our hero Mohamed Salah made it a day to remember. He was absolutely amazing on the field. He ran, he passed, and most importantly, he scored!

What is a Hat-Trick?

Okay, here's the really, really cool part! Mohamed Salah scored not just one goal, and not just two goals, but THREE goals in this one game! Wow! When one player scores three goals in a single football match, it has a very special name. It's called a "hat-trick"! Isn't that a fun word? Scoring a hat-trick is very difficult to do. It means the player is incredibly skilled and smart. They have to be in the right place at the right time, and they have to kick the ball perfectly into the net three times. It's a big celebration for any player. Mohamed Salah showed everyone how talented he is by scoring this wonderful hat-trick. Did you know? The idea of a "hat-trick" comes from the game of cricket! A long, long time ago, if a cricket player did something amazing three times in a row, they would sometimes get a new hat as a prize! That's how the name came to be used in football too!

More Than Just Goals!

But wait, there's even more! Mohamed Salah is not just good at scoring goals himself. He is also a great friend and a team player. After scoring his three amazing goals, he also helped his teammate score the fourth goal! This is called an "assist" in football. An assist means he made a perfect pass to another player, making it easy for them to score. It shows that Salah cares about his team winning together. He loves to help his friends on the field. So, he scored three goals and helped with one more! How incredible is that?

The Big Win!

Because of Mohamed Salah's amazing play, his team, Trabzonspor, won the game with a big score. They scored four goals, and the other team, Galatasaray, scored zero goals. The final score was 4-0! That's a huge victory for Trabzonspor. Galatasaray is a very strong team. They were even called the "Turkish champions" from before. What does "champions" mean? It means they were the best team last year! So, beating them by so many goals is a very special achievement. Everyone on Trabzonspor was very happy, and their fans cheered loudly.

Where is Turkey?

Turkey is a country that is mostly in Asia, but part of it is in Europe! It's across the Mediterranean Sea from some parts of Africa. It has beautiful cities and a rich history. Many people from different parts of the world, including Africa, go to Turkey for holidays or to work and play sports. It's a place where football is also very popular, just like in Africa. Did you know? Turkey is famous for its delicious food, like kebabs, and sweet treats like Turkish delight!

Why is This News Important for Africa?

This news about Mohamed Salah is very important for all of us in Africa. Mohamed Salah is a shining example of what African talent can achieve. When he scores goals and wins big games, it makes every person in Africa feel proud. He shows us that with hard work, practice, and determination, anyone, even a child from Africa, can become a world-class star. Salah inspires millions of young boys and girls across our continent to chase their dreams. He shows them that if you work hard and believe in yourself, you can reach the very top. He is a true role model and a hero for Africa. So, let's give a big cheer for Mohamed Salah! He reminds us all to dream big and work hard every day. That's all for today from your African Kids News! Keep playing, keep learning, and keep shining, amazing friends! See you next time!
summary: Our African hero, Mohamed Salah, a famous football star from Egypt, scored three amazing goals (a hat-trick!) and helped score another goal for his team, Trabzonspor, leading them to a big 4-0 win against Galatasaray in a football match in Turkey.
whyMatters: This news matters because Mohamed Salah is a proud African hero, and when he achieves great things like scoring a hat-trick, it inspires children all over Africa to dream big and shows them that with hard work, they can also achieve amazing success.

originalTitle: Asian Games: Smriti Mandhana breaks T20 record as India beat Bangladesh
title: Super Girls Play Cricket! India Reaches the Final!
content:
Hello, Sports Fans!

Hello, amazing friends in Africa! Your friendly news reporter is here! We have some super exciting news from a big sports party called the Asian Games. Imagine a giant playground where many countries come together to play different games! It's happening far away in a place called Asia. Today, we are going to talk about a very fun game called cricket. Have you ever seen cricket? It's a game with a bat, a ball, and lots of running!

What are the Asian Games?

The Asian Games are like a big festival of sports! Countries from Asia send their best athletes to play. They play many, many games like running, swimming, jumping, and of course, cricket! It happens every few years, and everyone gets very excited to see who will win. It's a time for friends from different countries to meet and compete fairly. Everyone tries their best, and it's a celebration of talent and friendship. Did you know that Africa also has big sports parties like this? They are called the All-Africa Games! Isn't that cool?

Let's Play Cricket!

So, what is cricket all about? Imagine two teams. Each team usually has eleven players. One team tries to hit a ball with a bat and score points, which we call "runs." The other team tries to get the players who are batting "out." When you get a player "out," it means they can't bat anymore for a little while. The game is played on a big green field. There are three wooden sticks called "wickets" that the bowlers try to hit. It's a very exciting game! Did you know that cricket started a very long time ago? It's played in many countries around the world!

India's Big Win!

Now, let's talk about the big game! Two teams of super girls were playing cricket. One team was from India, and the other team was from Bangladesh. Both are countries in Asia. The girls from India played amazingly well! They hit the ball very hard and scored so many runs. Imagine hitting the ball so far that you score lots and lots of points! That's what the Indian team did. They scored so many runs that the team from Bangladesh could not catch up. India won by a very big number of runs! They won by 114 runs. That's a huge win in cricket! It means they played super, super well. Everyone cheered loudly for the Indian team! They were so happy because they had won their match!

What is a "Run"?

When a player hits the ball and runs between two sets of wickets, they score a "run." If they hit the ball very far, they might even get four runs or six runs at once! It's like scoring a goal in football, but you get different points. The team with the most runs at the end of the game wins! So, the Indian girls scored many, many more runs than the Bangladesh girls. That's why they won big! Cricket players wear special pads and helmets to keep them safe. The ball is quite hard, so safety is very important!

Sri Lanka's Turn to Shine!

But wait, there was another exciting game happening too! Two other teams of super girls were playing. One team was from Sri Lanka, and the other team was from Pakistan. These are also countries in Asia. The girls from Sri Lanka also played incredibly well! They showed great skill and teamwork. They also tried their best to get the other team out and score runs. And guess what? Sri Lanka won their match too! They won against Pakistan. This means Sri Lanka also got a spot in the super exciting final game! Did you know that girls' cricket is becoming very popular all over the world? Girls are showing everyone how strong and talented they are!

The Grand Final!

So, now we have two super teams ready to play the very last game! This last game is called the "final." In the final, the two best teams play each other to see who will be the champion! It will be India playing against Sri Lanka! Can you imagine how exciting that will be? Both teams have played so well to get to the final. They will both try their very, very best to win the gold medal! The girls will show their fast bowling, strong batting, and amazing catching. Everyone will be watching to see who lifts the trophy! This final match is not just about winning; it's about sportsmanship and trying your best. It's about showing that with hard work, you can achieve amazing things!

Did You Know? Fun Cricket Facts!

* Did you know that some cricket matches can last for many days? But the games at the Asian Games are shorter, so we can see a winner quickly! * A cricket field is usually round or oval-shaped, like a giant egg! * The people who make sure the game is fair are called "umpires." They are like the referees in football. * Cricket is a game that teaches you teamwork, patience, and how to be fast! * Many countries in Africa, like South Africa and Zimbabwe, have their own super cricket teams too!

Why We Love Sports!

Isn't it wonderful to hear about all these amazing athletes playing their best? Sports teach us so much. They teach us to work together, to practice hard, and never to give up. Whether you play cricket, football, or any other game, remember to have fun and try your best! And always cheer for your favourite teams! We hope you enjoyed this exciting news from the Asian Games! Stay tuned for more fun sports stories! Bye for now!
summary: The Indian girls' cricket team played very well and won their match against Bangladesh by many runs, which means they will now play against Sri Lanka in the final game of the Asian Games.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows how strong and skilled girls are in sports, and it's exciting to see who will win the big cricket champion trophy for their country!

originalTitle: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
title: Ed Sheeran Talks About Kindness After Big Concert!
content:
Jambo, amazing friends! It’s your friendly news reporter here, bringing you big news from far away! Guess what? Our favorite singer, Ed Sheeran, had a big concert! You know Ed Sheeran, right? He's the super talented singer with the guitar who makes beautiful songs that make us want to dance or sing along. He’s famous all over the world, even here in Africa! Many of his songs are happy, and some make us think about important things.

Meet Ed Sheeran!

Ed Sheeran is a very special singer. He writes his own songs and plays his guitar so well. He has bright orange hair sometimes, and a big smile! People love his music because it's so catchy and full of heart. He sings about love, friendship, and even sometimes about feeling a little bit sad. Did you know? Ed Sheeran often uses a loop pedal when he performs. This means he records his own voice and guitar on the spot, then plays it back to make it sound like there are many instruments playing at once! It’s like magic!

A Big Concert Night!

Recently, Ed Sheeran had a very big concert. Imagine lots and lots of people, all cheering and singing along! It was a very exciting night. He sang many of his famous songs. Everyone was having a wonderful time, tapping their feet and clapping their hands. The lights were bright, and the music was loud and happy! Ed Sheeran loves to sing for his fans. But during this special concert, Ed Sheeran did something extra. He didn't just sing. He also talked to everyone there. He talked about some very important things that were on his mind. It was a serious moment in the concert, and everyone listened carefully.

Talking About Important Things

Ed Sheeran shared his feelings about a very sad problem happening far, far away in the world. He talked about two places called Israel and Gaza. Sometimes, people in these places are having a very difficult time. There is a lot of sadness and fighting. It's a really big and complicated problem, and it makes many people feel sad and worried. Ed Sheeran told everyone that he feels very sad about what is happening there. He also said something very important. He said he might have made some 'mistakes' when talking about it before. What does 'mistakes' mean here? It means he felt like he could have done things better or been kinder when he spoke. He wanted to make sure everyone understood that it's okay to feel different things, and that kindness is always important. He wants everyone to try and understand each other, even when things are difficult. He wanted to show that he cares about people, no matter where they are from. He talked about how important it is for everyone to live in peace. Did you know? Music has been used for hundreds of years to bring people together and to share important messages. Many songs from Africa tell stories of peace and community!

What Happened with Macklemore?

Before this concert, there was another singer called Macklemore. He is also very famous! Macklemore was supposed to sing with Ed Sheeran on his big tour. A 'tour' is when a singer travels to many different cities and countries to sing concerts for people. But then, Macklemore also talked about the problem in Israel and Gaza on stage. He shared his thoughts about the people in Palestine. After he said these things, something big happened. Macklemore was 'dropped' from the tour. This means he was not able to sing with Ed Sheeran anymore. It made many people talk and wonder why. This made the news because it showed how sensitive and difficult this big problem is. It made Ed Sheeran think about how he should talk about such serious things. He realized it's important to be careful and kind with words, especially when many people are listening. Did you know? Ed Sheeran started playing the guitar when he was just a little boy! He loved music from a very young age, just like many of you might love to sing or play!

What Does 'Mistakes' Mean for Ed?

When Ed Sheeran said he made 'mistakes,' he meant that he wished he had spoken more clearly or perhaps been more thoughtful about how his words might make different people feel. He learned that talking about very serious problems can be tricky. It's not always easy to say the right thing. But it's also a good thing to admit when you think you could have done better, isn't it? It shows that Ed Sheeran is a kind person who thinks about other people's feelings. We all make mistakes sometimes, and learning from them helps us grow and be better friends, children, and people. He wanted to send a message of kindness and understanding to everyone. He wants people to listen to each other, even if they have different ideas. He thinks that being gentle and caring is very important, especially when people are feeling hurt or sad.

Music Brings Us Together

Even when there are big problems in the world, music can still help us. Music can make us feel happy, and it can also help us think about sad things in a gentle way. It can help us understand that we are all people, and we all want to be happy and safe. Ed Sheeran's music often talks about connecting with others. He uses his songs to bring joy to people. He hopes that even when things are hard, music can be a way for people to feel a little bit better and remember to be kind to each other. Did you know? People all over the world, from big cities to small villages in Africa, listen to Ed Sheeran’s music! Music is a universal language, meaning everyone can understand and feel it, no matter what spoken language they use.

Listening and Learning

Ed Sheeran's message is a good reminder for all of us. It's important to listen carefully when people are talking, especially about things that make them sad or happy. It's important to try and understand how other people feel. And it's always, always important to be kind. We can all learn from Ed Sheeran. Even famous singers think about how they can be better and kinder. Let's remember to use our words to build bridges, not walls, and always spread love, just like Ed Sheeran does with his beautiful music! Keep shining, super kids!
summary: Famous singer Ed Sheeran talked about being kind and making 'mistakes' at a concert after another singer, Macklemore, was dropped from his tour for talking about a sad problem in Israel and Gaza.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that even famous people think about big problems in the world, and it teaches us to be kind, listen to others, and learn from our mistakes, especially when talking about sensitive things.

originalTitle: German elections under way which could decide fate of Chancellor Merz
title: Big Voting Day in Germany! Choosing a New Super Leader!
content:
Hello from Africa!

Jambo, amazing young friends! Your happy African news reporter is here with exciting news from far, far away! Today, we're going on an adventure to a country called Germany. It's a land with beautiful castles and delicious foods, and guess what? Something super important is happening there right now!

What is Happening in Germany?

Imagine it's a very special Sunday in Germany. Grown-ups are doing something called "voting." Voting is when people choose their leaders. It's like when you choose a class captain or a team leader for a game. They are choosing who will help run their whole country! Did you know? Germany is a big country in a part of the world called Europe! It's very far from Africa, but we can still learn about it!

Meet Mr. Merz, the Chancellor!

In Germany, the most important leader is called a "Chancellor." You can think of a Chancellor like the head teacher of a very, very big school – the whole country! This special leader helps make sure everyone has what they need and that the country runs well. Right now, a man named Mr. Merz is the Chancellor. He's been doing this big job for some time.

Being a Leader Can Be Tricky!

Being a leader is super important, but it can also be a bit tricky! Imagine you are the captain of a football team. Everyone on the team has ideas, and sometimes, the coach (the people of the country!) wants things done in a different way. Mr. Merz, the Chancellor, is feeling a bit of this pressure. It means many people are watching to see if they still want him and his team to lead.

What is a "Political Party"?

Now, imagine you and your friends want to build the best playground ever. You all have ideas, right? Maybe some friends want a big slide, and others want swings. In a country, groups of grown-ups who have similar ideas for making the country better form a "political party." Think of them as a team working together. Mr. Merz is part of a team, a political party. Did you know? Just like in sports, different political parties often have different ideas about how to make things better!

Why is This Vote Important for Mr. Merz?

Today, people are voting for which team they want to lead. If Mr. Merz's team gets lots of votes, it means most people want him to continue being the super leader, the Chancellor. But if his team doesn't get many votes, it's like not enough people chose them for the playground team. This could mean that Mr. Merz might not be the Chancellor anymore, and a new team and a new leader might take over. That's why this Sunday is a really, really big day for him!

How Do People Vote?

So, how do grown-ups choose? They go to special places, often schools or community halls. There, they get a special paper, like a test paper, but it's for choosing leaders! They mark their choice, then they put their paper into a secret box called a "ballot box." It's secret so no one knows who you voted for, and everyone can choose freely. Did you know? In some countries, people can even vote using computers or special machines! How cool is that?

Why Do We Have Elections?

Elections are super important because they let everyone have a say in who leads them. It's a fair way to decide. If you don't like how things are going, you can vote for a different team with different ideas. This helps make sure leaders listen to the people.

What Happens After Voting?

After everyone has voted, all the papers are collected and counted very carefully. It takes some time, but soon they will know which team won and who will be the new Chancellor or if Mr. Merz will stay. Did you know? Germany is famous for delicious foods like sausages and pretzels! Yum!

Why Should Kids in Africa Care?

You might be thinking, "Why should I, a kid in Africa, care about an election far away in Germany?" Well, that's a great question! Learning about other countries and how they choose their leaders helps us understand the big, wide world better. What happens in one country can sometimes have a little effect on other countries, even ours! Plus, it's just super interesting to learn new things.

Keep Learning, Keep Exploring!

So, there you have it, young adventurers! A big day in Germany where grown-ups are choosing their next super leader. Isn't learning about the world fun? Keep asking questions and keep exploring! Asante sana for joining me today!
summary: Grown-ups in Germany are having a special election day to choose their leaders, which will decide if Mr. Merz stays as their top leader, called the Chancellor.
whyMatters: This election is important because it shows how people in Germany choose their country's leaders and can help us understand how countries are run around the world.

originalTitle: Will the three-week break put more pressure on managers?
title: Big Football Break: What Happens to Our Coaches?
content:
Hello, my super football friends across Africa! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, ready to talk about something super cool: football! We all love watching our favourite teams score amazing goals, right? But today, we're going to talk about the special people who help our teams play so well: the coaches! Sometimes, grown-ups talk about 'pressure' and 'breaks' in football. It sounds a bit tricky, but don't worry! I'm here to explain it all in super simple words, just for you. So, let's kick off and learn what happens when there's a big, long break in football games!

What is a Football Coach?

A football coach is like a very special teacher for a football team. Imagine your best teacher at school, who helps you learn new things and become really good at them. That's what a coach does for football players! They teach the players how to kick the ball, how to pass it to a friend, and how to score goals. They also help the team work together like a big family. They show them special plans, called tactics, so they can win games. It's a very important job! Did you know? Some coaches in Africa have been coaching for a very long time, helping many young players become stars! They love football just as much as we do.

What is the 'Big Break'?

Sometimes, our regular football games – like the ones we watch every weekend – take a little holiday. This is called an 'international break.' It's like when your school has a long holiday, and you don't go to class for a few weeks. During this big break, the players don't just sit at home. Oh no! They go to play for their home countries. So, a player from Nigeria might leave his club team in Europe to play for the Nigerian national team. A player from Ghana might go home to play for Ghana. It's a time for countries to play against each other! This time, the break is even longer than usual. It's a three-week holiday from club football! That's a lot of time for players to be away from their regular teams. Did you know? Many amazing football players from Africa play for big teams all over the world! During international breaks, they come back to represent their home countries with great pride.

Why Do Coaches Worry During the Break?

Now, this is where it gets a little tricky for the coaches. Imagine you have a big school project, and your teacher wants it to be perfect. You feel a little worried about doing a super good job, right? That feeling is a bit like 'pressure.' Coaches feel this pressure too. They want their teams to win games and play very well. When the team doesn't win, sometimes the grown-ups who own the team decide that a new coach might be needed. This means the old coach might 'lose their job,' which means they stop being the coach for that team. This season, some coaches have already lost their jobs. So, other coaches, even if their teams are doing okay, might feel a little worried. They wonder if the long break will make things harder for them. They are 'looking over their shoulders,' which means they are thinking a lot about their job. Did you know? Even the best coaches in the world sometimes feel pressure. It's part of working with big teams and lots of fans!

What Do Coaches Do During This Long Break?

Do you think coaches just go on holiday during the three-week break? Not usually! Even though their players are away, coaches are super busy. They use this time to think and plan. They watch videos of their past games to see what went well and what could be better. They also watch other teams play to learn their secrets. They might even try to find new players who could help their team when games start again. They also talk to the players who stay behind. Some players might be a little hurt and need to rest, or they might not be playing for their country this time. The coach helps them keep fit and ready. Did you know? Coaches spend many hours watching football. They watch games from all over the world to get new ideas for their teams.

How Can Teams Help Their Coaches?

For a coach to be happy and not worried, their team needs to play well! When the players work together, pass the ball to each other, and score goals, the coach feels very proud. Fans, that's us, can also help! When we cheer loudly and support our team, it makes everyone feel good. It shows the coach that we believe in them and their plans. When the break is over, and the players come back, they will work very hard with their coach. They will practice all the new plans and try their best to win. If they play well, the coach will be happy, and so will all of us! Did you know? Football is called 'the beautiful game' in Africa because it brings so many people together, from different countries and different backgrounds, to share the joy of sports!

Let's Look Forward to More Football!

So, even though the long break might make some coaches think a lot, it's also a time for them to plan and dream big for their teams. Soon, our favourite football games will be back, and we'll be cheering and celebrating amazing goals again. Let's keep loving football and supporting our coaches and players! They work super hard to make us happy. See you next time, football friends! Keep cheering loudly for your teams!
summary: During a three-week international football break, coaches might feel worried about their jobs, even though they use this time to plan and prepare for future games with their teams.
whyMatters: This is important because coaches help our favourite football teams play well and win, so understanding their challenges helps us appreciate their hard work and cheer them on even more.

originalTitle: Townsend run over by pitch roller in Thailand
title: Oh No! A Big Machine and a Football Star!
content:
Jambo, amazing champions of Africa! Your friendly news reporter is here with a super surprising story! Guess what happened to a famous football player? He had a very, very funny and a little bit scary surprise before a big game!

Meet Our Football Friend, Andros!

Our story is about a famous football player named Andros Townsend. He is from a country far, far away called England. Andros is super good at football! Do you know what football is? It's the most wonderful game where players kick a round ball into a net to score points. We love football so much here in Africa, don't we? Andros is a 'winger'. That means he runs super fast along the sides of the football field. He helps his team score goals! He plays for big teams and travels all over the world to play this exciting game. Did you know? Football is also called soccer in some places like America! But here in Africa, we mostly call it football. It's the world's most popular sport!

What is a Pitch Roller?

Now, imagine a big, big machine. It's like a giant heavy tractor, but it doesn't dig dirt. This machine is called a 'pitch roller'. Can you guess what it does? It rolls over the grass on the football field! Why does it do that? Well, before a big game, the grass needs to be perfectly flat and smooth. If the grass isn't flat, the ball might bounce funny, and players might trip. So, the pitch roller makes the playing field super smooth and lovely for the players to run and kick the ball. Did you know? A football field is also called a 'pitch'! It has green grass, just like a big carpet for running and playing. These machines are usually very slow, but they are super heavy. You always have to be very careful around big machines like these!

A Big Surprise in Thailand!

So, Andros Townsend was not in England. He was in a beautiful country far away called Thailand! Thailand is in a continent called Asia. It's famous for lovely beaches, yummy food, and amazing temples. Andros was there to play a football game with his team. Before the game started, Andros was walking around the football pitch. Maybe he was looking at the grass, or just getting ready to play. While he was walking, the big pitch roller was busy doing its job, making the field smooth. Suddenly, by accident, the pitch roller moved over his leg! Oh no! Can you imagine that? A big, heavy machine rolling over a part of your body! It sounds quite scary, doesn't it? Did you know? Thailand is a country known for its friendly people and beautiful elephants!

Andros Makes a Joke!

But don't worry, my little champions! Andros Townsend is a very strong and brave man. And he is totally, absolutely fine! Phew! He wasn't badly hurt at all. It was just a big surprise and a bit of a shock! After it happened, Andros didn't cry or get angry. Instead, he did something very funny. He made a joke! Do you know what a joke is? It's when you say something silly to make people laugh. He laughed and said that playing a tough football game against a team called Stoke "wasn't so bad after all"! What he meant was that having a pitch roller go over his leg was a much bigger and funnier surprise than playing a hard football game. He was showing everyone that he was okay and could even laugh about it! It's wonderful to be able to laugh even when something surprising happens, isn't it? It shows how positive Andros is. Did you know? Making a joke can sometimes help you feel better when something surprising or a little bit scary happens!

Why Was Andros in Thailand?

Football players often travel all over the world! They go to different countries to play games, train with their teams, or sometimes even meet fans. Andros was in Thailand for a 'pre-season' tour. What is a pre-season tour? It's when a team travels to different places to play friendly games before their main football season starts. It helps the players get ready and fit for all the important matches to come. It's like practice, but in cool new places! Did you know? Many football teams from Europe come to Africa to play friendly matches, too! We love to welcome them!

Safety on the Field!

This story also reminds us about being careful. Even on a fun football field, there can be big machines or other things that need attention. We should always be aware of our surroundings, especially when big vehicles are moving. Adults who work on the football pitch make sure everything is safe for the players. And players also try to be careful. It's always important to look where you are going and pay attention! Did you know? Workers who drive big machines like pitch rollers have special training to make sure they drive safely!

The Happy Ending!

So, there you have it, my little friends! A famous football player had a very big surprise from a pitch roller in Thailand. But he was super brave, not hurt, and even made a joke about it! It's a reminder that even when funny or surprising things happen, we can be strong and positive. Andros went on to play his game, all safe and sound. Let's all remember to be careful around big machines and always try to find the funny side of things, just like Andros! Keep cheering for your favourite football teams, and stay safe, happy, and full of smiles! Goodbye for now!
summary: Famous football player Andros Townsend was accidentally run over by a large grass-flattening machine called a pitch roller before a game in Thailand, but he was completely unharmed and even made a joke about the surprising incident.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows us that even big surprises or accidents can happen, but it's important to stay safe, strong, and even find a way to laugh about it if you are okay, just like Andros did.

originalTitle: Mourinho and Simeone renew rivalry in Madrid derby after more than a decade
title: Big Coaches, Big Teams, Big Game in Spain!
content:
Hello, my super friends! Your friendly news reporter from Africa is here with exciting news about a game of football! Far, far away in a country called Spain, something really special is happening this Sunday. Two very important football coaches, Jose Mourinho and Diego Simeone, are meeting again for a super big football match!

Welcome to the Big Game!

Imagine two clever captains of two big teams. They both want their team to win very, very much! That's what Jose Mourinho and Diego Simeone are like. They are coaches for two amazing football clubs, Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid. These teams are from the same big city in Spain, called Madrid. When teams from the same city play, it's always a super exciting game!

Meet the Clever Coaches!

First, let's meet Jose Mourinho. He is a very famous coach from a country called Portugal. He has coached many big teams and won lots of shiny trophies! He is known for being very smart and making his teams play very well together. He always tries to find the best way for his team to score goals and not let the other team score. Then, there is Diego Simeone. He is from a country called Argentina. He used to play football himself, and he was very good! Now, he is the coach for Atletico Madrid. He is known for making his team very strong and working super hard. His teams are always tough to beat because they play with so much energy and passion. Did you know? A football coach is like a teacher for the players! They teach them how to kick the ball, where to stand, and how to work as a team to win the game.

Two Teams, One City: Real Madrid vs. Atletico Madrid

Let's talk about the teams! Real Madrid is one of the most famous football teams in the whole world! Their shirts are usually white, and they have won many, many championships. They have some of the best players who can kick the ball really far and score amazing goals. And then there's Atletico Madrid! They are also a super strong team and they wear red and white striped shirts. They play with a lot of heart and never give up. Their fans cheer very, very loudly for them! Did you know? The capital city of Spain is Madrid! That's why this game is extra special, because both teams are from the same city!

What is a Derby Match?

This game is called a 'derby'. A derby is a special football match between two teams who are from the same city or very close to each other. It's like when two friends from the same school play against each other in a game – everyone knows them, and everyone wants to see who will win! Derby games are often the most exciting ones because the fans of both teams live next to each other and want their team to be the best in their city. Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in the world! Lots of children, just like you, love to kick a ball around in Africa and everywhere else!

A Long, Long Wait!

Here's the really cool part! These two clever coaches, Jose Mourinho and Diego Simeone, have not been coaches playing against each other for a very, very long time! It has been 12 whole years! Can you imagine? 12 years is a lot! It's like when you were a tiny baby, or maybe not even born yet! So, it’s been a very, very long wait for this big match to happen again with these two coaches on the sidelines. Did you know? 12 years ago, many of the players who are playing now were probably still in school, just like you!

Why is This Match So Special?

This match is special because it's not just the players who are trying to win. The coaches also have a 'rivalry'. A rivalry means they both really want to win against each other because they are both super good at their job. They will both think very hard about the best way to make their team win. They will plan all the moves and tell their players what to do. It's like a big game of chess, but with a football! Jose Mourinho will want his team, Real Madrid, to show they are the best. And Diego Simeone will want his team, Atletico Madrid, to fight hard and win for their fans. It's going to be a super exciting game to watch! Did you know? In a football game, each team has 11 players on the field at one time! One of them is the goalkeeper, whose job is to stop the ball from going into the net.

Football Fun Facts!

Football is a game played with a round ball. The goal is to kick the ball into the other team's net to score a 'goal'. The team that scores the most goals wins! There is a person called a 'referee' who makes sure everyone plays fairly and follows the rules. The fans in the stadium will cheer and sing songs for their favourite team. It's a big, loud party! Did you know? When a player scores a goal, the fans jump up and down and cheer very loudly! It’s one of the most exciting parts of the game. Did you know? Real Madrid has a famous stadium called Santiago Bernabéu, and Atletico Madrid has a famous stadium called Cívitas Metropolitano. These are very big places where thousands of fans come to watch the game!

Who Will Win? The Excitement!

No one knows who will win this big game. Both teams are very strong, and both coaches are very clever. But one thing is for sure: it will be a game full of excitement, amazing kicks, super saves by the goalkeepers, and lots of cheering! Everyone will be watching to see which team and which coach will come out on top. So, get ready for a super Sunday of football fun from Spain! It reminds us that no matter where we are in the world, the love for football brings us all together, from the sunny pitches of Africa to the big stadiums in Spain!

Playing Fair and Having Fun

Even though it's a big rivalry and everyone wants to win, football is also about playing fair and having fun. The players shake hands before the game, and at the end, they show respect for each other, no matter who wins. That's a very important lesson for all of us! So, let's cheer for good football and a fantastic game!
summary: Two very clever football coaches, Jose Mourinho and Diego Simeone, will coach their teams, Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid, in a big game in Spain this Sunday after 12 years of waiting, promising an exciting city derby.
whyMatters: This is important because it's a super big game between two famous teams from the same city, led by two very smart coaches who haven't played against each other in a long, long time, so it will be a very exciting match for all the football fans!
